title: cdrgam.cli 0.2.0
text: Gives clean installations writable, cross-platform default CDR-GAM root R’s user data directory. Root-local .cdrgam/site.yml, registry, scheduler state, projects form one movable harness instance. CDRGAM_ROOT switches complete instance without splitting configuration data. Replaces exported checkout argument cdrgam_root. Existing sites migrate placing scheduler fields concurrency setting <CDRGAM_ROOT>/.cdrgam/site.yml omitting now-implicit cdrgam_root field. Speeds work-graph construction reusing source checksums file size modification time unchanged removing redundant filesystem probes managed-path construction. Reports current cdrgam run stage standard error. Interactive terminals receive -place, color-rotating activity indicator. Makes purge remove matching artifacts, attempts, logs, registry records, strengthens internal module boundaries focused development tests.

title: cdrgam.cli 0.1.0
text: Establishes first public development release CDR-GAM project harness. Provides version-controlled project definitions, validation, dependency planning, local execution, shared Slurm orchestration. Manages atomic artifacts, logs, status, cleanup, publication, retrieval across projects one configured harness instance.
